direction.camera: Guide attention with modular proof; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: one dominant feature leads a secondary grid of evidence; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with bento grid; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with ordered reveal.
direction.lighting: flat readable fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: clean white panels and technical glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around readable labels; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use modular proof,bento grid,feature hierarchy,measured rhythm,readable labels,ordered reveal as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
